verdict.rationale: Lever's own Automation Hub automates routine candidate actions such as archiving, tagging, emailing and advancing, and Advanced Nurture follows up automatically. That is direct, first-party action automation. The evidence never documents user-defined rule logic or which events trigger those actions. Webhooks are only outbound developer callbacks, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documentation of user-defined rule/condition configuration, an explicit list of triggering events, depth of the rule builder, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Lever's Automation Hub handles routine tasks like archiving, tagging, emailing, and advancing candidates.
Lever helps you immediately reconnect with previous candidates and follow up automatically.
